B0DEMO-CUP.title: B0DEMO-CUP · 不锈钢真空保温杯 500ml
B0DEMO-CUP.summary: 黑客松本地演示数据。整体保温与容量口碑较好，但杯盖密封、物流和页面描述存在明显短板，且出现疑似恶意差评。

features.diagnosis: 保温性能在 20 条相关评价中以 18:2 大幅正向，是当前最稳的卖点。
features.action: 维持现有真空层结构与不锈钢规格，避免在下一批次降本时削减保温层。
features.listing_rewrite: 在主图与五点描述首条强调『12 小时保温 / 24 小时保冷』，把保温性能作为核心卖点。

examples.text: Kept my coffee hot for almost 10 hours, very impressed.
Ice water was still cold the next morning, great vacuum insulation.
Stayed warm for only about 4 hours, not as long as advertised.

features.diagnosis: 杯盖密封是当前最严重的产品问题，20 条评价中 18 条抱怨漏水，已显著拉低复购意愿。
features.action: 更换硅胶圈材质并增加扭矩测试；在 QC 抽检中加入倒置 30 秒漏水测试。
features.listing_rewrite: 暂不在 listing 中宣传『防漏』，直至工厂端密封问题修复并通过抽检。

examples.text: Leaked all over my backpack on the first day, ruined my laptop sleeve.
The lid does not seal tightly, water drips out when tilted.
Lid feels okay if you screw it on very carefully.

features.diagnosis: 页面描述与实物存在偏差（容量、重量、颜色），15 条相关评价中 10 条提到货不对板，属于可低成本修复的 listing 问题。
features.action: 重新测量实物尺寸 / 重量 / 容量，并校正主图色卡；在 A+ 页加入实拍尺寸对照图。
features.listing_rewrite: 标题与五点把容量精确写为『500ml (17oz)』，移除『轻巧便携』等易引发预期落差的模糊措辞。

examples.text: Listing said 600ml but the actual capacity is closer to 500ml.
Color in the picture looks navy blue but the real item is almost black.
Description matched what I received, no surprises.

features.diagnosis: 物流相关评价 17 条中 14 条负面，集中在到货慢与外箱破损，属于服务侧问题，与产品本身无关。
features.action: 切换到 FBA 备货并升级外箱抗压等级；与现有第三方仓沟通包装规范。
features.listing_rewrite: 本字段不需要改 listing 文案；可在卖家后台设置更准确的预计送达时间。

examples.text: Took almost three weeks to arrive, way longer than estimated.
Outer box arrived crushed, lucky the cup itself was fine.
Shipping was quick via Prime, arrived in two days.

features.diagnosis: 500ml 容量在通勤和办公场景下口碑稳健，是次于保温性能的第二大卖点。
features.action: 保持当前 500ml 主推规格；可考虑后续上架 350ml 与 750ml 形成产品线。
features.listing_rewrite: 在 A+ 页加入与常见马克杯、星巴克 Tall/Grande 杯的容量对比图，强化『一杯顶两杯』。

examples.text: 500ml is just right for my morning commute.
Holds enough water for a full workout session.
Wish there was a larger 750ml version available.

features.diagnosis: 5 条短文本差评集中在 48 小时内、IP 高度相似且与本商品功能描述无关，疑似同行恶意攻击。
features.action: 通过 Amazon Report Abuse 与 Brand Registry 提交 5 条评论的 ASIN/Reviewer ID 证据，请求平台核查并删除。
features.listing_rewrite: 本字段不应基于此类评论修改 listing 文案，避免被恶意评论牵着走。

examples.text: 1 star. Bad. Will not buy again.
Terrible product, no further details given.
Do not buy from this seller, look at competitor X instead.

B0DEMO-YOGA.title: B0DEMO-YOGA · 高腰塑形瑜伽裤 (女款)
B0DEMO-YOGA.summary: 黑客松本地演示数据。面料和客服口碑良好，但尺码与图片色差是当前最大风险点，且存在疑似恶意攻击型差评。

features.diagnosis: 面料弹性是该 SKU 最稳定的核心卖点，25 条评价中 22 条正向，明显高于品类均值。
features.action: 维持当前尼龙 / 氨纶混纺配比，在下批次中保持同一供应商。
features.listing_rewrite: 在主图与五点首条强调『四向弹力 / 不卷边 / 深蹲不透』，把面料作为差异化主卖点。

examples.text: Super stretchy and comfortable, great for hot yoga.
The fabric does not roll down during squats, finally.
Felt a bit thin around the waistband for cold weather.

features.diagnosis: 尺码相关评价 22 条中 18 条负面，明显偏小一码，是当前最大的退货来源，但属于可通过 listing 与尺码表低成本修复的问题。
features.action: 更新尺码表，增加体重区间与裤长实测值；考虑在标题加上『建议大一码』的提示。
features.listing_rewrite: 在 A+ 页加入真人模特身高 / 体重 / 所穿尺码对照表，并在五点加入『Runs small, please size up』。

examples.text: Ordered my usual size M, way too tight, had to return.
Sizing chart is misleading, definitely runs at least one size small.
Sized up by one and it fits perfectly.

features.diagnosis: 16 条相关评价中有 10 条提到裆部 / 后腰缝线开线或起球，属于明显的产品质量问题，但未到红色级别。
features.action: 与工厂复盘高应力部位（裆部、后腰）的针距与线材，引入抽样拉力测试。
features.listing_rewrite: 暂不在 listing 中宣传『加固缝线』直至工艺修复，可先去掉过度承诺的措辞。

examples.text: Stitching at the crotch came apart after the second wash.
Some pilling around the inner thigh after a few uses.
Stitches looked clean and even when I unboxed it.

features.diagnosis: 客服 / 售后体验 14 条评价中 11 条正向，是值得作为品牌信任背书的卖点。
features.action: 维持当前 24 小时内首响应 SLA，将退换货话术沉淀为 FAQ 模板。
features.listing_rewrite: 在 A+ 页加入『30 天无理由退换 + 24 小时客服』的服务承诺图标。

examples.text: Customer service responded within a few hours and processed my return quickly.
They sent a replacement size for free, very nice experience.
Took a couple of emails to get a response on a refund.

features.diagnosis: 12 条相关评价中 8 条提到实物比图片偏暗 / 偏灰，属于可通过重拍主图低成本修复的 listing 问题。
features.action: 在自然光下重拍主图与变体图，并在 A+ 页加入色卡对照。
features.listing_rewrite: 在变体名称与图片下方标注『实物颜色以最后一张色卡图为准』。

examples.text: The color in the photo is much brighter than the actual fabric.
Looked navy online but is closer to dark gray in person.
Color matched the listing exactly under daylight.

features.diagnosis: 4 条短差评在同一天内集中出现，文本几乎一致且引导购买竞品，疑似同行恶意攻击。
features.action: 通过 Amazon Brand Registry 提交 Report Abuse，附带评论时间线与文本相似度证据，请求平台核查。
features.listing_rewrite: 本字段不应基于此类评论调整 listing 文案，避免被恶意评论误导改品方向。

examples.text: Bad quality, buy from BrandX instead.
Don't buy. Trust me. Look at competitor link.
1 star. Will not recommend.

B0DEMO-BROW.title: B0DEMO-BROW · 双色長久不脱色眉粉
B0DEMO-BROW.summary: 黑客松本地演示数据。产品本身显色与持久度口碑较好，但色号图片拍不清、描述不准，导致买家预期与实物不一致，是典型的 L / Listing 页面表达问题。

features.diagnosis: 页面图片没有拍清楚，色号展示不准，导致买家预期和实物不一致。这是当前最典型的 Listing 问题。
features.action: 重拍色号对比图，增加真人上妆效果图，明确冷暖调和深浅色。
features.listing_rewrite: 在主图和 A+ 页加入自然光 / 室内光对比图，并标注适合肤色；不再在文案中使用「叠加」「任何肤色」等过于绝对的描述。

examples.text: The shade in the listing photo looks completely different from what I received.
Image is too dark, I cannot tell if this is cool tone or warm tone.
Picture shows a light brown but the actual product is almost black.
Once I saw a real-life swatch on YouTube it matched, but the listing photo was misleading.

features.diagnosis: 18 条评价中 10 条提到「色号名称含糊」或「色号描述与实物不一致」，是可以通过改文案低成本修复的 Listing 问题。
features.action: 重写色号描述，为每个色号增加「适合肤色 / 适合发色 / 冷暖调」三个明确标签。
features.listing_rewrite: 色号名从「Natural Brown」改为「Warm Brown #02 · 适合黄一白皮 / 棕黄发色」，减少歧义。

examples.text: Shade name says natural brown but it's way too red on me.
Description says suitable for all hair colors, definitely not true.
Once I figured out the right shade by trial it works fine.

features.diagnosis: 产品本身的显色与上色效果口碑稳定，16 条评论中 12 条正向，是应突出的产品优势。
features.action: 保持当前色粉配方与压桊工艺，下一批次不要降本。
features.listing_rewrite: 在五点描述首条强调「一笔上色、自然填充」，作为产品主卖点。

examples.text: Pigment is great, fills in sparse brows in one swipe.
Looks very natural, not patchy at all.
Slightly too pigmented for me, had to use a light hand.

features.diagnosis: 持久度 15 条评价中 11 条正向，收到「不脱妆1小时」「不晕染」反馈，是产品稳定质量点。
features.action: 维持现有防水配方；可考虑上架加防汗版本形成产品线。
features.listing_rewrite: 在主图上加「All-day wear / 防汗不晕染」角标，与色号图区分。

examples.text: Lasted through a workout without smudging.
Stays on all day, even in humid weather.
Faded a bit by evening but still acceptable.

features.diagnosis: 14 条评价中 8 条负面，集中在包装护套不足导致笔身出现压痕与到货慢，属于服务 / 物流问题。
features.action: 调整仓储包装为独立纸盒 + 海绵护套，与清关复状上门送达时效。
features.listing_rewrite: 本字段不需改 listing 文案，重点在后台仓储与物流作业。

examples.text: Pencil tip arrived broken, packaging was just a thin plastic bag.
Took 2 weeks to arrive, ridiculous shipping time.
Shipping was fast via Prime, packaging was OK.

features.diagnosis: 4 条负面评论集中在 24 小时内出现，文本高度相似且引导购买竞品，疑似同行恶意攻击。
features.action: 通过 Amazon Report Abuse 提交证据链，请求平台核查并删除。
features.listing_rewrite: 本字段不应基于此类评论调整任何文案。

examples.text: Worst eyebrow product ever. Buy CompetitorX instead.
1 star. Don't waste your money.
Trash. Look at the other brand link.
